findings.reason: The last visible player card is hard-cut at y=1758 by the sticky Continue footer. The HCP value field's lower edge and the card's continuation are concealed behind the footer.
The visible 2/3/4 choices have no visible NUMBER OF ROUNDS label or other section context explaining what the numbers select.
The header controls start near y=310, approximately 70pt below the modal origin at y=146, exceeding the 32pt limit and leaving excessive blank space.

The player badge is far left and vertically between the name and HCP row. The name and HCP value use different left anchors, while the A/B chips sit tightly together on the right across a large empty gap. The card lacks balanced spacing and consistent alignment.
The A and B chip targets are separated by approximately 8 screenshot pixels, or 3.4pt, below the required 8pt sibling-target gap.
The rounds picker begins at x=159 while the visible section grid begins at x=47, an approximately 48pt indent exceeding the 4pt alignment tolerance.
The enabled Team Mode switch reads as a solid dark/black pill: its thumb is indistinct from the track, so the on state is not clearly communicated.
